solution_summary: As Decodo CEO Vytautas Savickas explains, “Decodo’s goal is to create a frictionless experience to allow customers to get to that ‘aha!’ moment as quickly as possible.” Decodo began its migration to Google Cloud in 2022. With Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) as the backbone of its infrastructure, Decodo now has a reliable system with built-in redundancy, meaning that if one of its instances fails, it can switch traffic to… Decodo uses insights gained from BigQuery to improve its services for its customers. The company uses A/B testing to understand how customers use its products and services. That data is fed into BigQuery and combined with other customer data to show the… Key components include Google Ads supports a core part of the deployed AI and data workflow described in the customer story; Google Analytics tracks guest web sessions and engagement to feed into BigQuery for comprehensive customer journey analysis; BigQuery stores and queries the analytics and AI-ready datasets.

solution_components.name: Google Ads
solution_components.role: Supports a core part of the deployed AI and data workflow described in the customer story.

solution_components.name: Google Analytics
solution_components.role: Tracks guest web sessions and engagement to feed into BigQuery for comprehensive customer journey analysis.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Stores and queries the analytics and AI-ready datasets that power the workload.

solution_components.name: Looker
solution_components.role: Provides the governed semantic layer, dashboards, and self-service analytics used by business teams.

solution_components.name: Cloud SQL
solution_components.role: Stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low latency.

solution_components.name: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
solution_components.role: Orchestrates the platform's containerized services and high-concurrency workloads.

business_outcome: Gains reliable, scalable architecture with migration to Google Cloud; Enables data-driven insights about product development and customer targeting with BigQuery; Achieves simple, seamless migration to Cloud SQL with Database Migration Service; Frees engineers to focus on product innovation thanks to Google Cloud managed services
